command: claude CLI 2.1.285 print mode (claude -p --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort high --tools '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <porting system prompt>, prompt file on stdin, run from an empty directory)
notes:
Kept defects and behaviours of the original:
- PC-ERRORS is incremented on every rejected name but never reset nor read by PCWIZ.
  Fix: MOVE 0 TO PC-ERRORS once a name is accepted.
- A name typed as spaces only has NAMEL > 0 and is accepted as a blank PC-NAME.
  Fix: add OR NAMEI = SPACES to the test at line 51.
- The EVALUATE tests PC-BACK = 'Y' before DFHCLEAR. So CLEAR on a state coming back from PCCONF shows step 2, not step 1.
  Fix: move the WHEN EIBAID = DFHCLEAR branch before the PC-BACK branch.
- SEND-STEP2 leaves AMTO as LOW-VALUES when PC-AMOUNT <= 0, so a zero or negative amount is not shown.
- ADD 1 TO PC-ERRORS has no SIZE ERROR. The port keeps the low-order 4 digits, so 9999 + 1 gives 0. This assumes TRUNC(STD); TRUNC(BIN) would keep the binary value up to 32767, and it cannot be seen from the CBL cards.
- MAIN-PARA only relies on the RETURN inside SEND-STEP1, CANCEL-WIZARD and SEND-STEP2 to stop. It would otherwise touch DFHCOMMAREA without a COMMAREA, and fall through into TAKE-NAME. The port returns after each of those paragraphs.

Port assumptions:
- NAMEL is taken as the length of the received NAME with trailing nulls stripped. It is 0 when the name is null or empty, or on MAPFAIL.
- NAMEI is padded with blanks (JUSTIFY=(LEFT,BLANK)).
- Symbolic-map fields the program leaves at LOW-VALUES are sent as strings of NUL characters, as PCM1O / PCM2O hold them. No attribute subfields are set.
- MOVE DFHCOMMAREA TO WS-STATE copies the whole 30-byte DTO. With an EIBCALEN below 30, the mainframe would read bytes past the passed COMMAREA; the port cannot reproduce that.
- executePcwiz only logs, because PCWIZ has no batch entry.
- handleTransaction, handleLink and submitPcm1 are convenience wrappers that drive runTask. They are not part of the proven path.

Facts contradicted: none found. The field-tested RESP check on the RECEIVE at line 48 (NORMAL) matches the source.
